name: ThemeVix Direct Chat Button
author: Themevix

sections.description:
ThemeVix Direct Chat Button adds a WhatsApp click-to-chat button to your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to contact you directly with pre-filled product information.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc. WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC.

Features

All of the following features are included and fully functional in this plugin:

  • Click-to-Chat Button – Add a chat button to your product and cart pages
  • Pre-filled Messages – Automatically include product name, price, and URL in the message
  • Multiple Button Positions – Place the button before/after add to cart, after summary, or after meta
  • Customizable Design – Choose from multiple button styles, sizes, colors, animations, and hover effects
  • Product / Category Exclusions – Hide the button on selected products or categories
  • Quick Reply Templates – Offer ready-made messages on product pages
  • RTL Support – Right-to-left layout option
  • GDPR Consent – Optional consent checkbox before chat links open
  • Privacy Notice – Optional privacy policy notice under the button
  • Shortcode Support – Use [tv_direct_chat] shortcode anywhere on your site
  • Gutenberg Block – Native WordPress block editor support
  • Mobile Responsive – Looks great on all devices
  • WooCommerce Integration – Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce product and cart pages
  • Message Placeholders – Dynamic content insertion for product information

A separate add-on (hosted on our website, not WordPress.org) can add extras such as a floating chat widget, multi-agent support, lead capture, analytics, and WooCommerce automation.

Learn more about the add-on

Message Placeholders

Available placeholders:
* {product_name} – Product name
* {product_price} – Product price
* {product_url} – Product URL
* {shop_name} – Your shop name
* {product_sku} – Product SKU

Shortcode Usage

Basic usage:
[tv_direct_chat]

With custom attributes:
[tv_direct_chat phone=”+1234567890″ text=”Contact Us” message=”Hi, I need help!”]

External Services

This plugin generates click-to-chat links that direct users to WhatsApp via the wa.me short-link service operated by Meta Platforms, Inc.

What data is sent and when:
Data is transmitted only when a visitor actively clicks the chat button. At that point, the browser opens a URL in the following form:

https://wa.me/<phone_number>?text=<pre-filled_message>

The phone number is the one you configure in the plugin settings. The pre-filled message may include product name, price, URL, shop name, and SKU — all sourced from your own WooCommerce store. No data is transmitted automatically or in the background.

Third-party service information:

  • WhatsApp (wa.me): https://www.whatsapp.com/
  • WhatsApp Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • WhatsApp Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy-eea
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/themevix-direct-chat-button directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to TV Direct Chat in your WordPress admin sidebar to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your chat phone number with country code (e.g., +1234567890).
  5. Customize the button text, style, and position as needed.
sections.faq:
What format should I use for the phone number?

Enter your chat phone number with country code, without spaces or dashes. For example: +1234567890

Can I use this without WooCommerce?

This plugin is designed specifically for WooCommerce. However, you can use the shortcode [tv_direct_chat] on any page.

How do I change the button position?

Go to TV Direct Chat in your WordPress admin sidebar and select your preferred position from the “Button Position” dropdown.

Can I customize the pre-filled message?

Yes! Go to the plugin settings and customize the “Pre-filled Message” field. You can use placeholders like {product_name} and {product_price}.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes, the button works with all WooCommerce product types including variable products.

Does this track or store my personal data?

This plugin does not collect usage analytics, tracking data, or telemetry. Button settings are stored only in your WordPress database. When a visitor clicks the chat button, their browser opens WhatsApp (wa.me) with the phone number and pre-filled message you configured — see the External Services section below.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. This plugin includes a built-in GDPR consent checkbox feature. When enabled, users must check a consent box before chat links open (including quick-reply template links). You can customise the consent text and link it to your Privacy Policy page. The plugin does not collect or store visitor personal data in WordPress.

What’s the difference between this plugin and the premium add-on?

This plugin includes a product/cart chat button, GDPR consent, exclusion rules, quick-reply templates, RTL support, and animation/hover effects. An optional add-on (sold separately, not hosted on WordPress.org) adds a floating chat widget, multi-agent support, lead capture, analytics, WooCommerce automation, and related extras.

Do I need a WhatsApp account?

Yes. This plugin creates click-to-chat links that open WhatsApp. You need an active WhatsApp account (personal or business) associated with the phone number you configure in the plugin settings. A WhatsApp Business account is recommended for professional use.
